messages:
Priya (oncall): Heads up — embeddings prod is seeing ~15% 503s for short requests in eu-west1 since 02:12UTC. Investigating. Can we fast-track a hotfix?
DeployBot: [automated] Incident created: INC-7123. Canary window open for release/embeddings-fix-2026. Rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. ETA 30m.
Ethan: Ack. What rollback criteria do we want if canary degrades?
Priya (oncall): Minimal: if token error rate > 5% or lat 99 > 1.2s on canary. Also if errors surface in rerank path.
Sam: Agree on those. Also want consumer-facing fallback to v1-embeds if >3% error propagation to callers.
Lina: Who can sign the expedite? I can +1 if ops and infra both ok.
Grace: I'm on infra — quick check shows kernel switch patch reduces mem spikes. I can sign.
Ethan: Code owner and QA here — I can +1 for quick canary deploy, but request we hold full 100% until telemetry looks clean for 2 consecutive 5m windows.
Priya (oncall): Roger. Lina, Grace, Ethan +1s?
Lina: +1 from me. :thumbsup:
Grace: +1 infra. :white_check_mark:
Ethan: +1 from eng. Will monitor traces.
Priya (oncall): DeployBot, please start canary now and pin image sha: `sha256:8b3f4a9` for rollback if needed.
DeployBot: Starting canary rollout for release/embeddings-fix-2026 -> target subset: eu-west1-canary. Image: sha256:8b3f4a9. Canary started at 02:19UTC. Healthcheck endpoint: `/health/embeds`.
Sam: Quick note: release notes snippet for support — "Mitigates intermittent 503s under short-request load by tuning allocator and kernel path." Will push to the release-notes channel.
Lina: Also ensure we tag observability with `hotfix:embeds-2026` and create a Grafana share.
Grace: Telemetry: memory tail looks lower already on canary host. Latency P95 stable.
Ethan: Seeing one 503 in last minute, investigating stack traces now.
Priya (oncall): If we hit the rollback criteria, I will call rollback. Otherwise after 10m of stable windows we proceed to 10%.
Ethan: Two consecutive 5m windows passed, no error spike. Proceed to 10%.
DeployBot: Rolling to 10% at 02:31UTC. Traffic shift in progress.
Sam: Noted. Support has the release note snippet and customer-facing blurb ready.
Grace: Infra alert — a single host had a transient KVM oom kill during shift, but autoscaler handled it. Does that trigger rollback?
Priya (oncall): Not yet — error rate stayed <1% and lat targets met. Keep watching.
Ethan: 10% window looks stable. Proceed to 50% when you're ready Priya.
Priya (oncall): Proceed to 50%. DeployBot, shift to 50% and keep pin.
DeployBot: Rolling to 50% at 02:42UTC.
Sam: Quick reminder: create rollback playbook link in the incident thread for SRE oncall.
Priya (oncall): Done — updated INCIDENT-7123 with rollback steps and image pin.
Grace: 50% stable after 6m, lat 99 at 0.9s, errors ~0.6%.
Ethan: I recommend final 100% after an additional 4m stable window.
Priya (oncall): Agreed — if no regressions by 02:48UTC we finish.
DeployBot: Rollout completed to 100% at 02:49UTC. All services reporting healthy.
Sam: Great work team. I'll publish the short hotfix release note now and tag customers in the monitoring list.
Priya (oncall): Closing expedite — will leave incident open for postmortem. Thanks. :heart:
